{{DISPLAYTITLE:Red Panther (''Tactics Advance'')}}
[[File:FFTA-spr-RedPanther.gif|left]]
[[File:FFTA-Panther.jpg|200px|right]]
{{Quote|Hunts its prey with swift leaps and poison claws.|Description}}
The '''Red Panther''' in ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]'' is a nimble beast related to the [[Coeurl (Tactics Advance)|Coeurl]]. It is among the first and most common enemies encountered, and is tough to bring down due to its high HP and [[Counter (ability)|Counter]] ability.

===Missions===

!style="width:15%"|Mission

!Turf Defense Mission: Help Nargai!
|The Coeurl and Red Panther here will likely move close enough to each other that the player can damage both at once with an area effect spell.
|-
!Turf Defense Mission: Help Kudik!
|Two Red Panthers defend their turf in this mission.
|-
!Mission #044: Snow in Lutia
|This is the first time that Red Panthers appear, and they can be difficult for an under-leveled clan. Take out the weaker [[Goblin (Tactics Advance)|Goblin]] first.
|-
!Mission #045: Frosty Mage
|The enemy [[Black Mage (Tactics Advance)|Black Mage]] in this mission controls two red Panthers and a Floateye.
|-
!Mission #004: Desert Peril
|Two Red Panthers and a Coeurl make up the core of the monsters in this mission.
|-
!Mission #052: Friend Trouble
|A record three Red Panthers have been attacking travelers heading though the Kudik Peaks.
|-
!Mission #051: Desert Rose
|There are two Red Panthers among the oasis guards.
|-
!Mission #034: Magewyrm
|The Red Panther and an Antlion must be defeated before the clan can reach Magewyrm Gerland.
|-
!Mission #054: For A Song
|The Red Panther is one of the three monsters here.
|}
